name: Default
shortDescription: Universal artifact repository manager for Maven, npm, Docker, PyPI and more, with the embedded H2 database.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated NEXUS_SECURITY_INITIAL_PASSWORD from the environment, then accept the Community Edition EULA in the onboarding wizard before components can be fetched or uploaded. The first start takes 2-3 minutes.
The JVM reserves about 2.7 GB of heap by default. Lower the -Xms/-Xmx values in INSTALL4J_ADD_VM_PARAMS on small servers.
